switch: QJS_EXPERIMENT_PROTO_IC=0/1; once before qjs CLI runtime creation; immutable; only guards inherited fill
preserve: H 24B/site, eager allocation, own IC, holder guards, normal fallback and serialization
clock: frozen native performance.now / CLOCK_MONOTONIC; external perf_counter_ns diagnostic separate
affinity: same fixed allowed CPU for all conditions; recorded, does not control host frequency/scheduling

stability.second_failure: PERFORMANCE_ENV_UNSTABLE; zero formal samples; no further variants

ratio_definition: ratio of internal ms/Run medians; <1 numerator faster; percent=100*(ratio-1)

bootstrap.unit: complete 16-process block shared by all cases

quartiles: Tukey median of sorted halves, excluding middle when odd
failures: retain; no automatic retry of executed positions or outlier deletion
copied_inputs: preserve original byte SHA; record LF normalized SHA separately; Git -text for exact scripts/inputs
collection_order: runtime identity -> one system CPU observation -> max3 precalibration -> 12 stability, at most one affinity rearrangement +12 -> pilots ->16 correctness ->384 formal
cpu_selection_rule: one /proc/stat 1s delta over allowed CPUs, minimum busy fraction/tie minimum index; alternate preselected on different reported sibling set if possible; at most one fail-triggered move, no benchmark CPU sweep
child_cpu_measurement: sequential direct subprocess; RUSAGE_CHILDREN utime/stime delta; whole process not internal region
